name: Wooden bookcase
description: A tall dark plank bookcase for a wall, about 1.2 × 0.4 × 2 m, open at the front: two thick sides, a back of vertical boards, a moulded top and four shelves packed with uneven rows of worn leather books in oxblood, green, indigo and tan, some leaning, some lying in stacks, and a pile of rolled scrolls.
